metrics.label: Floor price
metrics.hint: Lowest live unit price in the pool

metrics.label: Top offer
metrics.hint: Best standing offer on any unit

metrics.label: Top of the ladder
metrics.hint: Dearest unit right now

metrics.label: Pool value (moving)
metrics.hint: Sum of every unit’s moving price, always transitory

metrics.label: Average sale
metrics.hint: Mean of all sales

metrics.label: Market cap
metrics.hint: Floor × supply

metrics.label: Volume 24h
metrics.hint: USD traded in the last day

metrics.label: Volume 7d
metrics.hint: USD traded in the last week

metrics.label: Volume 30d
metrics.hint: USD traded in the last month

metrics.label: Total volume
metrics.hint: USD traded since mint

metrics.label: Sales 24h
metrics.hint: Units sold in the last day

metrics.label: Sales 7d
metrics.hint: Units sold in the last week

metrics.label: Swaps 24h
metrics.hint: Fungible swaps into or out of the pool

metrics.label: Differences paid 24h
metrics.hint: What the pool paid out sponsoring swaps

metrics.label: Change 24h
metrics.hint: Floor move over a day

metrics.label: Change 7d
metrics.hint: Floor move over a week

metrics.label: Sold
metrics.hint: Editions sold of the supply

metrics.label: Remaining
metrics.hint: Editions still on sale

metrics.label: Supply
metrics.hint: Editions across every lot

metrics.label: Listed
metrics.hint: Share of held units listed for sale

metrics.label: Owners
metrics.hint: Profiles holding at least one unit

metrics.label: Unique owners
metrics.hint: Owners ÷ supply

metrics.label: Whales
metrics.hint: Owners with five units or more

metrics.label: New owners 7d
metrics.hint: First-time holders this week

metrics.label: Solo items
metrics.hint: Looks sold one by one

metrics.label: Packs
metrics.hint: Sets of 4–7 looks

metrics.label: Drops
metrics.hint: Runs of up to 64 units

metrics.label: Creator royalty
metrics.hint: Share of every resale paid to the creator

metrics.label: Liquidity
metrics.hint: USD staked behind the pool’s pair

metrics.label: Staking APR
metrics.hint: Yield on staked liquidity

metrics.label: Stakers
metrics.hint: Profiles staking the pair

metrics.label: Sponsor reserve
metrics.hint: What the pool can pay out to sponsor swaps

metrics.label: Quest entrants
metrics.hint: Profiles in the pool quest

metrics.label: Live quests
metrics.hint: Stat quests still open

metrics.label: Pool coin
metrics.hint: Price of the pool’s club coin

metrics.label: Coin holders
metrics.hint: Holders of the pool’s club coin

steps.title: Apply
steps.hint: Open the application and the pool quest.

steps.title: Team
steps.hint: Hosts join automatically as the team.

steps.title: World & party
steps.hint: Link the world; throw the pool party.

steps.title: Lots
steps.hint: Solo looks, packs of 4–7 and drops.

steps.title: Price
steps.hint: Set the shelf; prices move from it.

steps.title: Fund with EGG
steps.hint: EGG funds and steers qualifying teams.

questions.text: What is {pool} for, in one sentence?
Which utility does a {pool} PFT carry first?
Who leads {pool}, and what has the team shipped before?
How many hosts and members are on the team?
Which world is the pool party, and what happens there?
Genre of the first pool party?
How many PFTs in the pool, and how many per drop?
How will you sell: solo, packs of 4–7, or drops?
Centre of the price band, in USD?
Which pools will you swap with, and who sponsors the difference?
Reserve set aside to pay swap differences (USD)?
Which three stats will you move this season?
What quests will the community play?
How much EGG are you asking for, and for what?
How will the community share in what {pool} earns?
